description: This file defines an Android activity class 'CaptionOverlayActivity' that overlays a caption on content, manages window caption settings, and handles caption area changes.

classes.name: CaptionOverlayActivity
classes.description: An activity that overlays a caption on its content and handles restricted caption area changes.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity; sets content view, configures caption overlay, hides status bar and action bar.

methods.name: onRestrictedCaptionAreaChanged
methods.description: Callback invoked when the restricted caption area changes; logs the new rectangle.
